proposedOverrides.summary: The Arabela are an Indigenous people of Loreto in Peru. Their history includes river and forest livelihoods, forced labour, changing settlements and continuing efforts to document and teach their language.

overrideClaims.text: The Arabela are an Indigenous people of Loreto in Peru. Their history includes river and forest livelihoods, forced labour, changing settlements and continuing efforts to document and teach their language.
overrideClaims.locator: Introduction, historical coercion, schooling and language sections.

scopeNotes: The generated Wikipedia summary is about a Czechoslovak television series. The researched summary overrides it in the runtime index; generated files are not edited by hand.
Arabela is treated as a living people, not an extinct state. The imported polygon interval does not establish its lifetime or a verified boundary in 1492.
The Arabela River drains to the Curaray within the Napo system. The card avoids the BDPI introduction’s simplified tributary wording.

1945 is an attested missionary encounter, not a claim of first-ever outside contact. Speculative direct descent from named older groups and unsupported assignment of regional seventeenth-century events are omitted.
Population, identity and mother-tongue census figures measure different things. No changing count is presented as a current number of fluent speakers.
ILV is a missionary source. Its generalizations about religion, leaders and current customs are not adopted as timeless descriptions.
Only the dictionary’s bibliographic description and listed contents were read. No claim of inspecting its full entries or hearing the 2012 audio is made.
The Casa de la Literatura indexed transcript and participant credits were read; a browser challenge prevented direct retrieval. The narrative is attributed, not universalized.
The teaching resource is described from publisher metadata. It includes other peoples’ activities and is not treated as direct archaeological or photographic evidence.
The industry-linked 2008 investigation and later article were considered but not used to decide the existence or absence of isolated peoples. No locations of vulnerable isolated groups are supplied.
Independent review, depth certification and geometry review remain pending.
